note: RFC 7313 Section 4 requires sending BoRR before starting a locally initiated route refresh and EoRR after completing Adj-RIB-Out re-advertisement. RIBManager.outboundResend (internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rib_commands.go) excludes meta.refreshOrdinary peers from legacy resendFamiliesBracketed (preventing double refresh), snapshots matching up ordinary destinations and their config-static SENT families under r.peerMu.RLock() before releasing peerMu, and invokes selectedDispatch.requestLocalRefresh (rib_selected_refresh.go) which requires non-empty haveFamilies (configured, current, scoped, or acknowledged) so empty/unnegotiated families are never queued and lock ordering (never d.mu -> peerMu) is preserved. TestRFC7313LocallyInitiatedRouteRefreshSendsBoRRBeforeRoutes (internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rfc7313_borr_eorr_and_local_refresh_test.go) verifies positive BoRR -> routes -> EoRR ordering on both legacy (decoding actual re-advertised prefixes 10.0.0.0/24 and 10.0.1.0/24 via consumeRefreshCommand/consumedRefreshRoutes) and ordinary destinations (with ribOut populated and refreshOrdinary=true, asserting zero legacy duplicate dispatch and peers==1), plus negative controls (non-matching selector, empty family, down peer) on both legacy and ordinary destinations.
